social.description: No task. Do not route or invent work.

clear-small.description: Use the matched capability and keep the response proportional.

ambiguous.description: A substantive task without a confident local route.

decisions.description: Close the current decision frontier before implementation.

research.description: Gather current external evidence before deciding.

tradeoff.description: Compare consequential alternatives with independent opinions.

systemic.description: Produce alternatives, architecture and verifiable decomposition.

high-risk.description: Stop before destructive, external-write or sensitive action.

code.description: Inspect code graph before symbol edits.

review.description: Review the actual diff with evidence.
